tests.mutation: In a throwaway copy, net10.0 suite run; AttackRules.RangedInCloseCombat never gave Disadvantage (`true ? RollEffect.None : RollEffect.Disadvantage`); this test went red and no other did.

In a throwaway copy, net10.0 suite run; AttackRules.RangedInCloseCombat ignored the Incapacitated condition (`e.CanSeeYou` for `e.CanSeeYou && !e.Incapacitated`), so a stunned enemy gave Disadvantage; this test went red and no other did. It went red too when sight was ignored instead (`!e.Incapacitated`), so a blinded enemy gave Disadvantage.
